concepts.summary: How the final answer is shaped: nested results, bases, sample sizes and caveats.
Comparison against the survey's assigned benchmark, including the cross-client exception.
Tool rejections, database failures and empty results returned as repairable feedback.
Requests for code, scripts or queries as a deliverable, and which fenced forms may leave the agent at all.
Persona, consumer persona and respondent-profile answers.
Ranking attributes against a KPI by VIP on product means, via partial least squares.
The per-turn sourced progress ledger and the step budget that ends the loop.
Grouping respondents by the shape of their ratings across attributes, by k-means.
Tenant and survey boundary rules: which client, organization and survey a run may read.
Writing the read-only scoped SELECT the nl2sql tool runs, and the dialect limits on it.
The pre-fetched survey analysis packet injected into turn 0.
Significance testing: anova, tukey, pearson, spearman, chi-square and pca.
Word clouds over open-ended answers and the trusted artifact fence around them.

workflows.summary: Shapes the final answer: nested result blocks, narrative reporting, bases, and withheld-artifact notices.
Governs persona and respondent-profile requests, from required retrievals to the allowed output shape.
Clusters respondents on their attribute rating profiles and reports each cluster's dominant ranges, stability and product mix.
Binds every query to the run's client and survey, and refuses or discloses anything outside it.
Turns a question into one read-only scoped SELECT, then repairs, rejects or diagnoses the result.
Pre-fetches and explains one survey's analysis packet so turn 0 already holds its measures.
Runs significance tests and PLSR, then reports them with their limits.
Keeps a sourced progress ledger across turns and forces a grounded answer when the step budget ends.
Resolves the assigned benchmark survey, authorizes the cross-client exception, and handles its absence.
Returns rejections, hints and failures to the model as repairable feedback instead of ending the run.
Builds word clouds only through the tool and fails closed on model-authored or invalid artifacts.
